scope: Meeting, video, and supervision scheduling follow-up

reports.finding: Subscriber quality fallback hid camera tiles; failed subscriptions removed participants.
reports.change: Retain tiles with recovery feedback; retry missing subscriptions with bounded backoff; reconcile after reconnect or tab resume.

reports.finding: Only visible meeting tabs suspended inactivity; other tabs did not know about the connected call.
reports.change: Short-lived, login-scoped meeting leases renew normal activity and suppress rejoin prompts across tabs; closing the call restores inactivity behavior; locked sessions remain locked.

reports.finding: New supervision used edit-only save permission; recurrence handlers updated team-meeting state; date lookup depended on the visible week.
reports.change: Separate creation from edit permission, route recurrence to supervision state, preserve explicit dates, display submission errors, and save/deliver multiple reminder offsets.

reports.finding: History authorization checked scheduling permission against supervisor id zero.
reports.change: Authorize current assigned supervisor, supervisee, or agency administrator with active agency membership and tenant-constrained history queries.

reports.finding: Parent height override stretched tiles; minimum tile sizes and thumbnail rows consumed the screen-share area.
reports.change: Remove stretch override, fit square tiles to available space, and reserve a single thumbnail row under prioritized screen content.

reports.finding: The room heading mapped three distinct meeting types to Town Hall.
reports.change: Display separate Town Hall, Leadership Circle, and Supervisors meeting labels without changing stored meeting type.
Remove the separate supervision booking form. Schedule supervision above recent sessions opens My Schedule with supervision and the selected supervisee/agency.
Send the initial in-app scheduling announcement only for occurrence zero of a recurring supervision or team-meeting series; preserve individual occurrence reminders.

validation.production_build: Passed, with existing Vite chunk/import warnings
validation.browser_scope: Local Chromium with mocked video SDK; six participants, three viewport sizes, and screen priority.

remaining_live_verification: Multi-person call on real devices and networks, including screen sharing and reconnecting a participant.
Stay in a call beyond the inactivity threshold while using a second app tab.
Deploy the migration and verify recurring supervision plus reminder delivery against the deployment database.
limitations: Live Vonage audio/video and Safari device behavior were not exercised.
Previously delivered duplicate notifications are retained.
Unrelated workspace changes are excluded from this commit.
